name: Agentic Governance & Security Controls (COHUMAIN Labs & SafeAlign AI)

controls.title: Autonomous System Oversight
controls.description: Continuously observe autonomous agent behaviour against a defined baseline and enable timely human intervention.

controls.title: Emergency Stop & Containment (Kill Switch)
controls.description: Provide a single, fast mechanism to halt, contain and isolate an AI system on a safety or security trigger.

controls.title: Content Safety & Misuse Prevention
controls.description: Prevent generation of harmful, unsafe or policy-violating content and resist misuse and jailbreaks.

controls.title: Output Factual Accuracy & Anti-Hallucination
controls.description: Ensure factual grounding of generative outputs and detect and mitigate hallucination.

controls.title: AI Output Monitoring & Safeguards
controls.description: Monitor AI outputs at runtime for bias, harm, hallucination and drift, gating regulated decisions to humans.

controls.title: Autonomy Boundary Control
controls.description: Constrain each agent to an explicit, technically-enforced action space.

controls.title: Human Oversight & Intervention
controls.description: Guarantee accessible, timely human review, intervention and override of AI decisions and actions.

controls.title: Decision Interpretability
controls.description: Provide audience-appropriate explanations for AI outputs affecting people's rights, safety or health.

controls.title: Model Explainability
controls.description: Make model decision logic explainable for accountability, audit and error-correction.

controls.title: Output Labeling & Action Attribution
controls.description: Label AI-generated content and attribute autonomous agent actions to the agent.

controls.title: Data Provenance & Input Integrity
controls.description: Establish lineage and integrity of training and runtime inputs, including retrieval and tool data.

controls.title: AI Change Governance
controls.description: Govern behaviour-altering AI changes (model, prompt, data, tool, config) with re-evaluation triggers.

controls.title: Third-Party & Supply-Chain Oversight
controls.description: Assess and contractually bind AI suppliers and the model supply chain.

controls.title: Model Training Governance
controls.description: Ensure secure, reproducible, bias-screened model training with documented data lineage.

controls.title: Model Evaluation
controls.description: Validate model quality, bias, robustness and use-case suitability before deployment.

controls.title: Model Continuous Improvement & Drift Management
controls.description: Manage production drift with monitoring thresholds and retraining triggers.

controls.title: AI Lifecycle & Registry Management
controls.description: Version and govern all AI artefacts (model, prompts, tools, memory, agent configs) across the lifecycle.

controls.title: Environmental & Carbon Governance
controls.description: Estimate and govern the environmental and carbon footprint of AI training, hosting and inference.

controls.title: Multi-Agent Coordination Security
controls.description: Secure inter-agent communication, hierarchy and emergent behaviour in multi-agent systems.

controls.title: Agent Identity & Least-Privilege Authorization
controls.description: Give each agent a unique identity with just-in-time least-privilege authorization.

controls.title: Prompt Injection & Adversarial Input Defense
controls.description: Detect and block direct and indirect prompt-injection and adversarial inputs.

controls.title: Observability, Anomaly Detection & Incident Response
controls.description: Emit per-call agent traces, detect behavioural anomalies and run AI-specific incident response.

controls.title: AI Threat Modeling
controls.description: Model AI-specific and agentic-orchestration threats pre-deployment and map them to mitigations.

controls.title: AI Security Testing & Red-Teaming
controls.description: Test AI systems against adversarial, injection, jailbreak and extraction attacks in the release pipeline.

controls.title: Memory & Context Lifecycle Security
controls.description: Isolate, govern and expire agent memory and context to prevent leakage and poisoned persistence.
